description: The pie chart, titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM),” visually represents the proportional allocation of token routing among three components in the FedHLM framework: a large green segment labeled “LLM” accounts for 94.5% of the distribution, a smaller red segment labeled “EDGE_P2P” represents 3.9%, and a narrow blue segment, also labeled “EDGE_P2P,” accounts for 1.6%. The chart uses distinct colors—green for the dominant LLM component, red and blue for the two EDGE_P2P subcomponents—with percentage values explicitly labeled inside each slice. A small gray legend box is present in the lower right, though its label is not visible in the image. The chart emphasizes the overwhelming dominance of the LLM in token routing, with EDGE_P2P components collectively making up just over 5%, suggesting a highly centralized routing strategy within the federated hybrid language model architecture.
